title: Demon vs Warrior Clash
description: A massive blue demonic minotaur with golden armor, horns, and a flowing red cape charges forward roaring, clashing with a long-haired human warrior wielding two glowing blue curved blades. The scene is set in a chaotic battlefield with floating debris, shattered stone, and a large cracked green orb in the background under a dramatic sky.
